entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Checked 2026-09-09. Original [DAMIT model 271](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/271), version 2016-04-22. Convex lightcurve model at the archive fixed-shape diameter of 7.4 ±0.2 km. Model fields and mesh measurements.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The older nonconvex model 272 is only a plausible alternative. - No registered reflectance texture is available. Grid marks missing imagery; Elevation is shape-derived radius relative to a sphere, not measured geology.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.
